name: M&T Bank
description: M&T Bank is a Buffalo-based regional bank holding company with $213.5B of assets and $166.9B of deposits, concentrated in the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic. It earns 72 percent of its $9.7B revenue from net interest income (the gap between loan and deposit rates) and the rest from fees such as trust and wealth management and service charges. Retail Bank is the biggest segment (50 percent of revenue), ahead of Commercial Bank and Institutional Services and Wealth Management. It returned $2.66B through buybacks in 2025.

businessLines.name: Commercial Bank
businessLines.how: Lends to and takes deposits from commercial clients; 73 percent of revenue is net interest income (2,152 of 2,947, computed) with the rest fees (noninterest income up 18 percent in 2025).

businessLines.name: Retail Bank
businessLines.how: Branch-based consumer and small-business banking in the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic; 81 percent of revenue is net interest income (3,947 of 4,868, computed), which fell 8 percent in 2025.

businessLines.name: Institutional Services and Wealth Management
businessLines.how: Institutional Services provides trustee, agency, investment management and administrative services to corporations and institutions that use capital markets financing structures, paid as fees; Wealth Management advises wealthy clients for fees on assets; 58 percent of segment revenue is noninterest income (907 of 1,562, computed).

businessLines.name: All Other
businessLines.how: Not a customer business: treasury, funding and unallocated items.

brands.name: Wilmington Trust, N.A.
brands.note: Named in the 10-K glossary as a subsidiary; results sit in Institutional Services and Wealth Management and other segments (split not extracted).

brands.name: M&T Realty Capital
brands.note: Commercial real estate lending subsidiary of M&T Bank in the Fannie Mae DUS program.
